title: GraphQL test generation: schema-to-executable coverage
objectives: Implement the worked example and validate its boundary conditions
Use the diagnostic evidence to explain a release decision
relevance: In the fictional CI quality platform, this skill connects graphql test generation: schema-to-executable coverage with test contracts, failure triage, and evidence for release. Acceptance requires parse/validation success for intended valid cases, expected errors for invalid cases, no duplicate case IDs, complete requirement traceability and successful execution of exported candidates.

sections.title: Problem and intuition
paragraphs: The generator receives a synthetic schema and query or mutation. Its job is to propose tests tied to schema and business rules, not to execute arbitrary generated code. Required arguments, nullability and enums are structural contracts; authentication, ownership and quantity limits require independent domain rules.
The portfolio result must be reproducible from the supplied synthetic fixtures and declared configuration. Keep a deterministic baseline visible alongside any live-provider results.

sections.title: Implement the mechanism
paragraphs: Parse the operation and schema with graphql-core, generate structured case definitions and validate each operation. Add explicit positive, omitted-required, invalid-enum, boundary and authorization cases. Export candidate tests with requirement IDs and execute them against the synthetic resolver before accepting the artifact.
The repository labs provide the domain entry points and fixture cases. Run the acceptance checks before recording project completion and keep the generated run ID in your field notes.

python local-labs/evals/runner.py --output artifacts/evaluation

sections.title: Break it and diagnose it
paragraphs: HTTP 200 may contain GraphQL errors. A generated case with no meaningful assertion is rejected even if execution succeeds. Mutate a resolver rule to prove the accepted suite detects its target behavior; compare unique requirement coverage rather than raw candidate count.
Trace the actual effect and retain the counterexample as a regression fixture. Fixing presentation alone does not establish that the application boundary is safe.

sections.title: Problem and intuition
